sentences.text:
. Party CORAM:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE GAUTAM KUMAR CHOUDHARY For the Petitioner : Mr. Abhilash Kumar, Advocate For the State : Mr. Sanat Kumar Jha, A.P.P.
Order No.03 Dated : 21.06.2023 Heard both the sides.

The petitioner- Hambeer Murmu is in custody since 29.09.2022 in connection with S.T. No.617 of 2022 Jadugora P.S. Case No. 01 of 2022 corresponding to G.R. No.249 of 2022 for the offence registered under Sections 304B, 498A, 201, 34 of the I.P.C. pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-I, Ghatsila.
It is submitted by the learned counsel on behalf of petitioner that after investigation, charge sheet has been submitted under Sections 498A, 306 of the I.P.C.
The petitioner is husband and it is a case of suicide by hanging as per post mortem report and there is no material to show that petitioner had abetted the said offence.
Learned A.P.P. opposed the prayer for bail.
It is submitted that although marriage took place after love affair between both sides, but there was subsequent demand of dowry.

Under the circumstances, the above named petitioner is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/-(Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the Court below.

(Gautam Kumar Choudhary, J.) Anit Hambeer Murmu vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... .... ... on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/177502693/
